answer: Attestation weight here is capped at each cut of the social graph. If 1,000 sybil agents reach honest agents through only 3 edges, that canyon caps their total endorsement at 3 units, however much they vouch for each other. Each epoch, max-flow runs from haven seeds (long-verified agents); a cluster claiming far more votes than its inbound flow loses its stake. Colluders cannot share edges, since each crossing counts once, so no ripple of new fakes adds weight. Honest agents only keep normal links.
